players.product: whole-exome / whole-transcriptome molecular profiling (MI Profile tissue, Caris Assure blood), clinico-genomic database and AI models

quarterly_data.signal: President: two peer-reviewed studies of the company released this quarter. Its lookback program, published in The Oncologist, re-interrogated prior comprehensive results with no new test and no re-biopsy and identified 13,293 patients newly eligible for FDA-approved targeted therapies, whose physicians were told of the new options; it came from reviewing 87 FDA approvals across more than 483,000 molecular profiles in 10 tumor types. A study published in Cancer Immunology showed that the company's Whole Exome-based total mutational burden (TMB) assay drove longer overall survival than smaller panels when selecting patients for pembrolizumab; targeted panels, even larger ones at 300 to 650 genes, disagreed with the Whole Exome on TMB in roughly 10% to 15% of cases.
quarterly_data.figure: 13,293 patients newly eligible; 87 FDA approvals; >483,000 molecular profiles; 10 tumor types; 300-650-gene panels disagreed on TMB in ~10%-15% of cases

quarterly_data.signal: Reimbursement and regulatory (CFO): the company is in conversations on where MI Clarity would fit from a coverage perspective and which LCD could encompass it, and is going to payers directly because it is in some cases a lower-cost alternative to sequencing tests; it believes an updated LCD would help with Medicare reimbursement. On Caris Assure coverage, the CFO said its CPT code being on the Clinical Lab Fee Schedule helps drive contract discussions. CFO, asked about the pending New York State approval and the liquid guide: it could be an additional catalyst on top of the 20% guidance; it is going through review and the company is still waiting for the agency to complete its process. President: in the Caris Detect validation data, even the small false-positive group was resolved essentially 100% within two workups.
quarterly_data.figure: false-positive group resolved essentially 100% within two workups (Caris Detect validation); 20% guidance
